svg.text: One gate, five bots, counted separately
FREE_REQUESTS AI-powered actions per user per bot, then a native Telegram Stars invoice.
FREE ALLOWANCE · FREE_REQUESTS = 5 per user, per bot
request 6 triggers the invoice — navigation, /start, uploads and quiz buttons never consume the allowance
MULTI / INCR on the free counter
retries up to 8 times on WatchError
payload validated against this user id
OPTIONAL USDT PATH · disabled unless USDT_WALLET_ADDRESS is set
/verify <txid> stores a pending record keyed by sha256(txid)
PAYMENT_ADMIN_IDS receive Approve / Reject inline buttons
approval is manual by design: a wallet address cannot prove an on-chain payment
render.yaml leaves USDT_WALLET_ADDRESS blank — the default path is Stars only
ceiling holds at exactly 5 free actions
50 concurrent reservations never exceed the ceiling
payload signature rejects a foreign user id
Pricing, allowance and lifetime are environment settings (FREE_REQUESTS · STARS_PRICE · PAID_ACCESS_DAYS): changing them needs no rebuild.
Telegram Stars are the only path enabled by default for selling digital access inside a bot.
